positions.name: DeriveIdGuarantee
positions.frame: what must the derive-id path guarantee when headings carry no explicit id field?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere under the read of derive-id behavior under missing-id conditions: src-1 asserts the test reproduces the production failure pattern (## heading, no id), and src-2 directs the expected outcome — no crash, valid slug. The set holds the tension between reproducing a failure and mandating safe handling.
